hypotheses.title: No trusted starting point
hypotheses.statement: Young professionals experience uncertainty about where to turn because they lack a regular doctor or have limited HMO support.
hypotheses.origin: Alaga pitch deck v10, slide 4 (faithful transcription).

hypotheses.title: Disrupted health routines
hypotheses.statement: Young professionals have difficulty maintaining healthy habits because desk work and commuting reshape their daily schedule.
hypotheses.origin: Alaga pitch deck v10, slide 4 (faithful transcription).

hypotheses.title: Wellness without clarity
hypotheses.statement: Young professionals feel uncertain about health progress because fitness habits alone do not explain their underlying health.
hypotheses.origin: Alaga pitch deck v10, slide 4 (faithful transcription).

hypotheses.title: Motivation without direction
hypotheses.statement: Young professionals have difficulty choosing what to change because willingness to act outpaces personalized health guidance.
hypotheses.origin: Alaga pitch deck v10, slide 4 (faithful transcription).

hypotheses.title: A personal health concern
hypotheses.statement: Young professionals worry about future health risks because a flagged result or family history raises unanswered questions.
hypotheses.origin: Alaga pitch deck v10, slide 4 (faithful transcription).

hypotheses.title: Care takes too much time
hypotheses.statement: Young professionals delay tests and follow-ups because separate visits compete with work and other commitments.
hypotheses.origin: Alaga pitch deck v10, slide 4 (faithful transcription).
